---
title: "HSMA 6 Modules"
subtitle: "Recordings · Slides · Exercises"
body-classes: neon-title
toc: false
title-block-banner: resources/banner.png
include-back-link: false
page-layout: full
grid:
  sidebar-width: 0px
  body-width: 1100px
  margin-width: 300px
  gutter-width: 1.5rem
listing:
    - id: modules
      contents: "hsma_content/modules/current_module_details/*.qmd"
      sort: "date"
      type: grid
      grid-columns: 2
      categories: false
      template: html/modules/module_listing.ejs
---

```{=html}
<style>
/* Shared neon colours, fonts, .neon-tile, .tile-header, .crt-screen, .neon-button and .page-jump live in styles.css */

/* ---- Intro panel: the homepage's "Updates from the HSMA team" terminal panel, holding two tiles ---- */
.modules-intro {
    margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem 0;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background-color: #262626;
    border: 1px solid #3d3d3d;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.modules-intro-header {
    padding: 0.7rem 1.5rem;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #7a000b, #9c000d 45%, #6d0f4f);
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    border-image: var(--neon-gradient) 1;
    color: white;
    font-family: var(--terminal-font);
    font-size: 1.7rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-align: center;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 120, 140, 0.55);
}

.modules-intro-header .prompt {
    color: #ff8a90;
}

.modules-intro-header .cursor {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.55em;
    height: 1em;
    margin-left: 0.1em;
    background-color: currentColor;
    vertical-align: -0.12em;
    animation: intro-cursor-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite;
}

@keyframes intro-cursor-blink {
    50% { opacity: 0; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .modules-intro-header .cursor {
        animation: none;
    }
}

.modules-intro-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 1.25rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
}

.intro-tile {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem 1.25rem 1.5rem;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.intro-tile p {
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.intro-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.7rem;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: var(--terminal-font);
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 18%, transparent);
    color: var(--accent-soft);
}

.intro-heading {
    margin: 0.75rem 0 0.6rem 0;
    font-family: var(--display-font);
    font-size: 2.1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: white;
}

.intro-tile .page-jump {
    margin-top: auto;
}

/* ---- Route map: modules 1-8 as stops on a line. Dashed links are modules that stand alone;
        solid neon links mark the two that build on the module before ---- */
.module-map {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(8, minmax(0, 1fr));
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0.75rem 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
}

.module-map li {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
}

/* Link back to the previous stop */
.module-map li + li::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 21px;
    right: 50%;
    width: 100%;
    border-top: 2px dashed #555;
}

.module-map li.map-dep::before {
    border-top: 3px solid transparent;
    border-image: var(--accent) 1;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--accent-glow));
}

.map-node {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid var(--accent-soft);
    background-color: #1c1c1c;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
    color: white;
    font-family: 'HSMA Display Solid', var(--display-font);
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    line-height: 1;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease;
}

.map-node:hover {
    color: white;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 25%, #1c1c1c);
    box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* Module 1: the start of every route */
.map-start .map-node {
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 30%, #1c1c1c);
    box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--accent-glow), 0 0 2px white;
}

.map-label {
    margin-top: 0.4rem;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.15;
    opacity: 0.85;
}

.map-tag {
    margin-top: 0.3rem;
    padding: 0 0.35rem;
    border-radius: 3px;
    font-family: var(--terminal-font);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 18%, transparent);
    color: var(--accent-soft);
}

.map-key {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem 1.25rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    opacity: 0.8;
}

.map-key span::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 22px;
    margin-right: 0.4rem;
    vertical-align: middle;
    border-top: 2px dashed #777;
}

.map-key .key-dep::before {
    border-top: 3px solid var(--neon-magenta);
    box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(224, 33, 138, 0.6);
}

.intro-route .neon-list {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

.intro-route .neon-list li {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 400;
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
    .modules-intro-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        padding: 1.25rem 1rem;
    }

    .modules-intro-header {
        font-size: 1.35rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .map-label {
        display: none;
    }
}

/* Phones: smaller stops so all eight fit on one line */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .map-node {
        width: 32px;
        height: 32px;
        font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .module-map li + li::before {
        top: 15px;
    }

    .map-tag {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
}

/* ---- Module cards: one per row like the Books shelf, with the module number in the HSMA lettering,
        the art pinned to the top of its CRT screen with an on-screen hours readout, and the topic
        lists in two columns on wide cards so the longer modules don't run on ---- */
.module-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    margin: 2rem 0 1rem 0;
}

.module-card {
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 0;
    container-type: inline-size;
    scroll-margin-top: 6rem;   /* clear the navbar when jumped to from the route map */
}

.module-card-inner {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: clamp(220px, 28%, 300px) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: stretch;
}

.module-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    min-height: 5.2rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem;
}

.module-num {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-width: 1.6ch;
    padding-right: 0.9rem;
    border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 45%, transparent);
    font-family: 'HSMA Display', var(--display-font);
    font-size: 3rem;
    line-height: 1;
    text-align: center;
    color: white;
    text-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* Override the shared listing title's forced capitalisation and padding */
.module-card .module-title {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: var(--terminal-font);
    font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2.2vw, 1.5rem);
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.15;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: white;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
}

.module-screen {
    align-items: flex-start;   /* keep the art at the top of tall cards */
    border-radius: 0 0 0 12px;
}

/* The art and its readout move together on hover, rather than just the image */
.module-screen-frame {
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

a.module-screen:hover img {
    transform: none;
}

a.module-screen:hover .module-screen-frame {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
}

.module-screen img {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    object-fit: cover;
}

/* On-screen display in the corner of the picture, like a TV's channel readout */
.module-osd {
    position: absolute;
    right: 0.5rem;
    bottom: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0 0.5rem;
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 55%, transparent);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    z-index: 1;   /* above the CRT overlay, so it stays readable on bright art */
    font-family: var(--terminal-font);
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent-soft);
    text-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-glow);
}

.module-body {
    flex-grow: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem 1.5rem 2rem;
    /* Divider between the screen and the details, in the module's colour */
    border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 40%, transparent);
}

.module-abstract {
    flex-grow: 1;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.module-abstract p {
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

/* "It covers" (or "We will cover"), as a terminal prompt in the module's colour */
.module-abstract .module-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    font-family: var(--terminal-font);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent-soft);
}

/* "It covers" lists: rows with a small neon marker in the module's colour */
.module-topics {
    margin: 0 0 0.75rem 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
}

.module-topics li {
    position: relative;
    padding: 0.3rem 0 0.3rem 1.1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

.module-topics li:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.module-topics li::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0.85em;
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 1px;
    background-color: var(--accent-soft);
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* Wide cards: topic lists in two columns */
@container (min-width: 900px) {
    .module-topics {
        column-count: 2;
        column-gap: 2.25rem;
    }

    .module-topics li {
        break-inside: avoid;
    }

    .module-topics li:last-child {
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    }
}

/* Narrow cards (phones): screen above the details */
@container (max-width: 560px) {
    .module-card-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .module-screen {
        justify-content: center;
        border-radius: 0;
    }

    .module-screen-frame {
        max-width: 260px;
    }

    .module-card .module-body {
        padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
        border-left: none;
        border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 40%, transparent);
    }
}

.module-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem;
}
</style>
```

```{=html}
<span class="intro-badge"><i class="bi bi-calendar-check"></i> April 2024 – June 2025</span>
<p class="intro-heading">Free to all</p>
```

The content below relates to the now complete HSMA 6, which ran from April 2024 to June 2025.

All of this content can be freely accessed if you want to learn these things outside of a dedicated HSMA cycle or are not eligible to join the next round of the HSMA programme.

Click into the module you are interested in to find a full list of the sessions within that module, including links to the session recording, the slides, and the code-based exercises and solutions.

Prefer to read a summary of the content covered in these sessions? Head to the [books](books.qmd) page instead.

[<i class="bi bi-book"></i> Go to the books page](books.qmd){.page-jump}

:::

::: {.intro-tile .intro-route .neon-tile .neon-tile--spectrum}

```{=html}
<span class="intro-badge"><i class="bi bi-signpost-split"></i> Pick your route</span>
<p class="intro-heading">How the modules fit together</p>
```

Modules are listed in the order they are delivered on the course, but while module 1 is essential for all other modules, most of the remaining modules can be consumed independently.

```{=html}
<ol class="module-map" aria-label="Module route map">
  <li class="map-start neon-tile--red"><a class="map-node" href="#module-1" aria-label="Module 1">1</a><span class="map-label">Python</span><span class="map-tag">Start here</span></li>
  <li class="neon-tile--blue"><a class="map-node" href="#module-2" aria-label="Module 2">2</a><span class="map-label">DES</span></li>
  <li class="neon-tile--magenta"><a class="map-node" href="#module-3" aria-label="Module 3">3</a><span class="map-label">Geo</span></li>
  <li class="neon-tile--green"><a class="map-node" href="#module-4" aria-label="Module 4">4</a><span class="map-label">ML</span></li>
  <li class="map-dep neon-tile--dusk"><a class="map-node" href="#module-5" aria-label="Module 5">5</a><span class="map-label">NLP</span><span class="map-tag">After 4</span></li>
  <li class="neon-tile--sunset"><a class="map-node" href="#module-6" aria-label="Module 6">6</a><span class="map-label">SD &amp; ABS</span></li>
  <li class="neon-tile--spectrum"><a class="map-node" href="#module-7" aria-label="Module 7">7</a><span class="map-label">Git &amp; Web</span></li>
  <li class="map-dep neon-tile--ocean"><a class="map-node" href="#module-8" aria-label="Module 8">8</a><span class="map-label">Analytics</span><span class="map-tag">Uses 7A</span></li>
</ol>
<div class="map-key" aria-hidden="true"><span>Stands alone (after module 1)</span><span class="key-dep">Builds on the module before</span></div>
```

The only exceptions are

```{=html}
<ul class="neon-list">
  <li><i class="bi bi-cloud-upload" aria-hidden="true"></i>deploying reproducible reports online in module 8 (an optional exercise) relies on github content from session 7A</li>
  <li><i class="bi bi-chat-square-text" aria-hidden="true"></i>natural language processing in module 5, which benefits from completing module 4 (machine learning) first</li>
</ul>
```

:::

```{=html}
<!-- CRT bloom for the module art, as on the homepage carousel: blurs the image, keeps only the brighter
     parts of the blur, and screens them back over the original -->
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position: absolute;" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
  <filter id="crt-bloom" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%" color-interpolation-filters="sRGB">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="5" result="blur"/>
    <feComponentTransfer in="blur" result="highlights">
      <feFuncR type="linear" slope="1.6" intercept="-0.6"/>
      <feFuncG type="linear" slope="1.6" intercept="-0.6"/>
      <feFuncB type="linear" slope="1.6" intercept="-0.6"/>
      <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.5"/>
    </feComponentTransfer>
    <feBlend in="SourceGraphic" in2="highlights" mode="screen"/>
  </filter>
</svg>
```
